latest.author: Shabbypenguin
latest.text: Due to how sandboxing is, the homebrew cant access folders outside of their own title. i include an ftp server and http web server to upload roms. when you launch the title and connect to ftp client it should already be in the expected "roms" folder for the game. putting them there, or using the web server to upload them should get you working great :).
